subject: Execution roadmap & MAP: MosaicCare implementation and close timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@mosaiccare.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@mosaiccare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Execution roadmap & MAP: MosaicCare implementation and close timeline

Alyssa / Tom — congrats again on the signed SOW. Removing friction after signature is the ask here; attached is a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP) and an evaluation plan we recommend embedding into the implementation cadence. Key points / proposed timeline: 

- Target go-live: 2028-08-14 (4 weeks from now)
- Week 0 (now — 7/18): Provisioning & infra prep (VPC peering, KMS keys, service accounts) — owners: Redwood infra + Mosaic infra
- Week 1 (7/22): Model onboarding, config, baseline dataset ingestion, and initial smoke tests
- Week 2 (7/29): Canary window (limited tenant traffic) + train-the-trainer session (internal ops)
- Week 3 (8/5): Full environment regression, security review, eval run against our sample prompt set
- Week 4 (8/12–8/14): Final cutover and monitored go-live

Evaluation plan highlights (also attached):
- Success criteria: P95 latency < 220ms, error rate < 0.5% for live traffic; embedding throughput >= 120 reqs/min under steady-state; quality thresholds defined per prompt set via automated eval harness
- Regression guardrails: holdback traffic and automatic rollback triggers (detailed in EvalPlan PDF)

Open asks for MosaicCare:
1) Confirm go-live window (target above) or propose blackout windows to avoid (billing cycle or releases)
2) Procurement contact for billing/PO coordination (cc if possible)
3) Acceptance of the MAP milestones and owners or propose updates

Files attached: MosaicCare_MAP_v1.xlsx, EvalPlan_MosaicCare_v1.pdf, Signed_SOW_20280715.pdf

If that looks reasonable, I'll publish MAP v1.1 with updated milestones and share the canary monitoring runbook with ops.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@mosaiccare.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@mosaiccare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Execution roadmap & MAP: MosaicCare implementation and close timeline

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan and congrats team. A few quick notes from MosaicCare side: 

- Procurement: please include procurement@mosaiccare.com on any billing/PO threads; they will need the SOW + pricing appendix to generate the PO.
- Blackout week: our product team has a scheduled maintenance window 7/30–8/2 that will affect any canary traffic. Can we shift the canary window one week later (i.e., canary in week 3 instead of week 2)?
- Training: we prefer a split training approach — one train-the-trainer + two optional regional sessions. The dates you suggested look workable if we move canary.

Inline: 
> Target go-live: 2028-08-14 (4 weeks from now)

This is still fine for us assuming the canary shift; procurement will confirm PO timing early next week.

Thanks —
Alyssa
Director, Product Ops
Alyssa Chen
alyssa.chen@mosaiccare.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@mosaiccare.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@mosaiccare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@mosaiccare.com
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution roadmap & MAP: MosaicCare implementation and close timeline

Thanks Alyssa — good catch on the blackout. I've pushed the canary window one week later and attached v1.1 of the MAP and EvalPlan with the revised milestone dates. High-level changes in MAP v1.1: 

- Canary window moved to Week 3 (08/05–08/09)
- Train-the-trainer moved to 07/29 (virtual) and regional end-user sessions scheduled for 08/06 and 08/07 (two 90-minute sessions)
- Added evaluation criteria section (pass/fail gates) and the sample prompt set that will be used for regressions
- Rollback triggers added to canary runbook: sustained error-rate > 0.5% for 10 minutes OR P95 latency degradation > 35% above baseline

Evaluation plan (summary):
- Baseline: we will run the Redwood eval harness against your provided sample prompts (attached) and a synthetic traffic replay of 30 minutes at expected peak TPS
- Measurement: latency percentiles, 99/95/50; token-level cost estimate; qualitative spot-checks for hallucination rate (QA team to review 50 samples)
- Acceptance: signed off by MosaicCare product + Redwood CS lead before final cutover

I've also added the HubSpot deal id (HS-45672) to the doc and shared the Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MosaicCare/MAP_v1 .

Next actions: 
- Procurement (procurement@mosaiccare.com) to confirm PO timing and billing contact
- Mosaic product to confirm the sample prompt set by 07/24
- Redwood to schedule train-the-trainer (Jonas/Marissa) for 07/29

Attachments: MosaicCare_MAP_v1.1.xlsx, EvalPlan_MosaicCare_v1.1.pdf

Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@mosaiccare.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Execution roadmap & MAP: MosaicCare implementation and close timeline

Quick internal note — ops and monitoring assignments below (publishing so Mosaic has visibility):

- Canary monitoring lead: Marissa Cole (on-call 08/05–08/09) — responsibilities: observe telemetry, run smoke scripts, escalate to engineering on anomalies
- Rollback owner: Laura Bennett — authorized to flip the route back to fallback cluster if rollback criteria hit
- Eval harness execution: Redwood QA (runbook attached: CanaryMonitoringRunbook.md)
- Communication cadence: daily stand (10am PT) during the canary window; status posted to shared channel and a final canary report within 24 hours of window close

I'll coordinate internal runbooks and will share access to the monitoring dashboards by 07/27.

Marissa
Director, Customer Reliability
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@mosaiccare.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@mosaiccare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@mosaiccare.com
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Execution roadmap & MAP: MosaicCare implementation and close timeline

All good on our end — we accept the revised MAP and timeline. Procurement is looping in a PO owner and will aim to get the PO completed before the train-the-trainer session. Appreciate the clarity on rollback and evaluation criteria.

We will provide the sample prompt set by 07/24 and confirm the regional attendee list for the end-user sessions. Looking forward to 07/29 training.

Thanks,
Tom
VP, Engineering, MosaicCare
